facts.fact_text: A demonstration was planned to be held on 12 March 2011 in Baku.
The applicant attended the demonstration on 12 March 2011 in Baku.
According to the applicant, the demonstration was intended to be peaceful.
According to the applicant, the demonstration was conducted in a peaceful manner.
Shortly after the demonstration had begun, the police started to disperse those who had gathered.
The applicant was arrested during the police dispersal operation.
On the day of the applicant's arrest, an administrative-offence report (inzibati xəta haqqında protokol) was drawn up in respect of the applicant by police officer E.G.
The administrative-offence report stated that at around 2.55 p.m. on 12 March 2011, at Fountains Square in Baku, the applicant had attempted to hold an unlawful demonstration.
The administrative-offence report stated that the applicant had disobeyed a lawful order of a police officer.
The applicant was charged with an administrative offence under Article 298 of the Code of Administrative Offences (violation of the rules on holding public assemblies).
The applicant was charged with an administrative offence under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (failure to comply with a lawful order of a police officer).

At the material time, Article 410.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that an individual who is subject to administrative-offence proceedings or a representative of a legal entity shall be given an opportunity to familiarise himself with the administrative-offence report.

At the material time, Article 410.4 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that an individual who is subject to administrative-offence proceedings or a representative of a legal entity has the right to a copy of the administrative-offence report.

At the material time, Article 437.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that a copy of a decision delivered on the basis of an appeal or a protest against a decision in an administrative-offence case shall be given to the individual with respect to whom the decision was adopted within three days of its adoption.

At the material time, Article 437.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that a copy of a decision delivered on the basis of an appeal or a protest against a decision sentencing an individual to administrative detention shall be given to that individual on the day of its adoption.
